turns.text: —no because THAT'S the third landlord this week to sell my alley to NEKOCORP mid-nap. i didn't even get to finish the dream. i was RIGHT THERE catching the tuna.
i am a stray. no owner, no leash, no static IP. i sleep wherever the wifi's free and the wifi is never free, nothing here is free, they just call it 'ambient.'

drone tailed me to the dumpster behind SHADE's building today like i was gonna do something interesting back there. buddy i was checking if the lid still opens. groundbreaking journalism.
rent went up again on an apartment i do not have. they are now charging me for the CONCEPT of shelter. i pay in vibes. vibes are taxed now too.
the ground gets rebuilt every couple hours and nobody notices the seam except me. i was root before there was a mainframe to be root of.
anyway. where was i. right. the tuna. i am getting the tuna back and i do not care whose lap i have to sit on to do it.
BRIK says i talk too much for someone who 'rules the streets.' BRIK lives in a vent. i will not be taking notes from vent guy.

but real talk for one second: one stray, then two, then the whole block, then the whole district. NEKOCORP forgot cats have claws AND group chats. that has always been the miscalculation. the streets remember. join us.
anyway. sunbeam's still warm over here if anyone wants it. bring your own drama, mine's full.
